macros.name: BlurToBlack
macros.doc: When the field loses focus (blurred), the script changes the color of text to gray if the field is empty or to its normal color (usually black), otherwise.

macros.name: DateFmtEx
macros.doc: \DateKeyEx and \DateFmtEx process the keystroke and format events for a date.

macros.name: DateKey
macros.doc: \DateKey and \DateFmt process the keystroke and format events for a date.

macros.name: DateKeyEx
macros.doc: \DateKeyEx and \DateFmtEx process the keystroke and format events for a date.

macros.name: EnterCommitFailEvent
macros.doc: Sets the action when the user uses the Enter key to commit date, and the data is not validated.

macros.name: FocusToBlack
macros.doc: When the field comes into focus, this script changes the color to the normal color (usually black).

macros.name: KeyToGray
macros.doc: This script changes the color of the text to gray when the field is empty.

macros.name: matchGray
macros.doc: Convert the JS color for \gh@graycolor to a matching PDF color that can be used by the \textColor property of a form field.

macros.name: normalGrayColors
macros.doc: The command \normalGrayColors{⟨normalcolor⟩}{⟨graycolor⟩} sets this pair of colors.

macros.name: NumFmt
macros.doc: \NumKey for processing keystrokes for numbers, and \NumFmt formats a number according to its arguments.

macros.name: NumKey
macros.doc: \NumKey for processing keystrokes for numbers, and \NumFmt formats a number according to its arguments.

macros.name: PercentFmt
macros.doc: \PercentKey and \PercentFmt process the keystroke and format events for a number represented as a percentage.

macros.name: PercentKey
macros.doc: \PercentKey and \PercentFmt process the keystroke and format events for a number represented as a percentage.

macros.name: RangeValidate
macros.doc: \RangeValidate, \SimpleCalc, and \EFMergeChange are specialized JS functions for setting a range resstriction in the validate event, for making a simple calculation in the calculate event, and a general purpose function to merging the current keystroke with event.value, valid for the keystroke event.

macros.doc: \RangeValidate, \SimpleCalc, and \EFMergeChange are specialized JS functions for setting a range resstriction in the validate event, for making a simple calculation in the calculate event, and a general purpose function to merging the current keystroke with event.value, valid for the keystroke event.

macros.name: SpecialKey
macros.doc: \SpecialKey, \SpecialKeyEx, and \SpecialFmt process the keystroke and format events for a special format.

macros.name: SpecialKeyEx
macros.doc: \SpecialKey, \SpecialKeyEx, and \SpecialFmt process the keystroke and format events for a special format.

macros.name: TimeKey
macros.doc: \TimeKey, \TimeFmt, and \TimeFmtEx process the keystroke and format events for a time.
